p: seven months: They thought by continuance of time the plague would have ceased, and so would have kept the ark still.
a trespass offering: The idolaters confess there is a true God, who punishes sin justly.
gods: This is God's judgment on the idolaters, that knowing the true God, they do not worship him correctly.
jewels of gold: Meaning, the golden emerods and the golden mice.
he hath done us this great: The God of Israel.
chance that happened to us: The wicked attribute almost all things to fortune and chance, whereas indeed there is nothing done without God's providence and decree.
them unto the border of Bethshemesh: For the trial of the matter.
they clave the wood of the: That is, the men of Bethshemesh, who were Israelites.
Ashdod one: These were the five principal cities of the Philistines, which were not all conquered to the time of David.
had looked into the ark of: For it was not lawful for anyone either to touch or to see it, only to Aaron and his sons Nu 4:15,20.
